dedupe_keys.name: stormwater filter water quality and quantity data treatment of road runoff in the city of vantaa finland

description: Harri Koivusalo publishes water-quantity and water-quality measurements from road-runoff filters in Vantaa, Finland. Zenodo serves an XLSX under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The public description says six monitoring campaigns took place in 2017 and 2019 for sand and mixed sand–biochar treatments. A modeller can use the measurements to calibrate filter removal or flow-response assumptions in urban stormwater treatment simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these Vantaa filter campaigns. A limitation is that the landing page does not name analytes, sampling frequency, storm-event conditions or the exact filter geometry. Six campaigns at one city cannot establish performance under all climates, salt loads or maintenance states. The workbook was not downloaded, so variable units, sample counts and treatment-effect estimates were not independently checked. The cited paper details also need bibliographic verification.
